insights: Apple's design system uses a consistent cubic-bezier(.4,0,.6,1) easing curve across all navigation animations creating a unified, polished motion language
The navigation employs sophisticated staggered animations with CSS custom properties (--r-globalnav-flyout-item-number) to calculate individual item delays dynamically
Button radius is consistently rounded-lg (8px via CSS variable --sk-button-border-radius) across all CTA variations, with rounded-full reserved exclusively for icon-only buttons
